ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Refer to the diagram. What animal shown is a carnivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a food web, with the bottom labeled “Meadow Grasses”; arrows point from the grass to Deer, Rabbit, and Vole; the arrow from Rabbit points to Coyote and Hawk; the arrow from Deer also points to Coyote; the arrow from Vole points to Hawk. Then reason: in a food web, arrows indicate the flow of food or energy to the organism that eats it. A carnivorous animal is an animal that eats other animals. In the image, Coyote receives arrows from Rabbit and Deer, indicating that Coyote eats animals, so it is a carnivore.
